page.overview:
What is Esso Promotion?

The Esso Promotion is a promotion run by Esso petrol Stations on several LEGO City sets. When spending more than £20 on fuel in an Esso petrol station, customers were able to purchase one of six City themed polybag sets for £1.50. The following six sets were available:
